final_wiki.answer-Q-4875: The greatest common divisor (GCD) of 143 and 253 is **1**. This is verified using the Euclidean algorithm: 253 ÷ 143 = 1 with a remainder of 110; then 143 ÷ 110 = 1 with remainder 33; then 110 ÷ 33 = 3 with remainder 11; then 33 ÷ 11 = 3 with remainder 0. The last non-zero remainder is **1**, confirming that 143 and 253 are **coprime**.
